nodes.en: Multidimensional grids and data
nodes.zh: 多维网格与数据

nodes.en: Abstract
nodes.zh: 摘要

nodes.en: This chapter introduces key concepts of the thread organization and thread-to-data mapping in CUDA. It first gives an overview of the multidimensional organization of CUDA threads, blocks, and grids. It then elaborates on the use of thread indexes and block indexes to map threads to different parts of the data, which is illustrated with a two-dimensional (2D) image color-to-grayscale conversion example and a 2D image blur example. The chapter concludes with a matrix multiplication example that will be used extensively in later parts of the book.
nodes.zh: 本章介绍 CUDA 中线程组织方式以及线程到数据映射的关键概念。首先概述 CUDA 线程、线程块与网格的多维组织；随后详细说明如何利用线程索引和线程块索引把线程映射到数据的不同部分，并以一个二维（2D）图像彩色到灰度转换的例子和一个 2D 图像模糊的例子加以说明。本章最后给出一个矩阵乘法的例子，本书后续部分将大量使用该例子。

In 【1】Chapter 2【/1】, Heterogeneous Data Parallel Computing, we learned to write a simple CUDA C++ program that launches a one-dimensional grid of threads by calling a kernel function to operate on elements of one-dimensional arrays. A kernel specifies the statements that are executed by each individual thread in the grid. In this chapter, we will look more generally at how threads are organized and learn how threads and blocks can be used to process multidimensional arrays. Multiple examples will be used throughout the chapter, including converting a colored image to a grayscale image, blurring an image, and matrix multiplication. These examples also serve to familiarize the reader with reasoning about data parallelism before we proceed to discuss the GPU architecture, memory organization, and performance optimizations in the upcoming chapters.
nodes.zh: 在【1】第 2 章【/1】“异构数据并行计算”中，我们学习了编写一个简单的 CUDA C++ 程序：通过调用核函数启动一维线程网格，对一维数组的元素进行运算。核函数规定了网格中每个线程各自执行的语句。本章将更一般地考察线程的组织方式，并学习如何用线程和线程块来处理多维数组。全章将使用多个例子，包括把彩色图像转换为灰度图像、对图像做模糊处理，以及矩阵乘法。在后续章节讨论 GPU 体系结构、内存组织和性能优化之前，这些例子还有助于读者熟悉对数据并行的推理方式。

nodes.en: 3.1 Multidimensional grid organization
nodes.zh: 3.1 多维网格组织

nodes.en: In CUDA, all threads in a grid execute the same kernel function, and they rely on coordinates, that is, thread indices, to distinguish themselves from each other and to identify the appropriate portion of the data to process. As we saw in 【1】Chapter 2【/1】, Heterogeneous Data Parallel Computing, these threads are organized into a two-level hierarchy: A grid consists of one or more blocks, and each block consists of one or more threads. All threads in a block share the same block index, which can be accessed via the 【2】blockIdx【/2】 (built-in) variable. Each thread also has a thread index, which can be accessed via the 【3】threadIdx【/3】 (built-in) variable. When a thread executes a kernel function, references to the 【4】blockIdx【/4】 and 【5】threadIdx【/5】 variables return the coordinates of the thread. The execution configuration parameters in a kernel call statement specify the dimensions of the grid and the dimensions of each block. These dimensions are available via the 【6】gridDim【/6】 and 【7】blockDim【/7】 (built-in) variables.
nodes.zh: 在 CUDA 中，网格内的所有线程执行同一个核函数，它们依靠坐标（即线程索引）彼此区分，并确定各自应处理的数据部分。正如我们在【1】第 2 章【/1】“异构数据并行计算”中所见，这些线程被组织成两级层次结构：一个网格由一个或多个线程块组成，每个线程块由一个或多个线程组成。同一线程块中的所有线程共享相同的线程块索引，该索引可通过【2】blockIdx【/2】（内置）变量访问。每个线程还有一个线程索引，可通过【3】threadIdx【/3】（内置）变量访问。当线程执行核函数时，对【4】blockIdx【/4】和【5】threadIdx【/5】变量的引用返回该线程的坐标。核函数调用语句中的执行配置参数指定网格的维度以及每个线程块的维度。这些维度可通过【6】gridDim【/6】和【7】blockDim【/7】（内置）变量获得。

nodes.en: In general, a grid is a three-dimensional (3D) array of blocks, and each block is a 3D array of threads. When calling a kernel, the program needs to specify the size of the grid and the blocks in each dimension. These are specified by using the execution configuration parameters (within 【1】<<<【/1】…【2】>>>【/2】) of the kernel call statement. The first execution configuration parameter specifies the dimensions of the grid in number of blocks. The second specifies the dimensions of each block in number of threads. Each such parameter has the type 【3】dim3【/3】, which is an integer vector type of three elements 【4】x【/4】, 【5】y【/5】, and 【6】z【/6】. These three elements specify the sizes of the three dimensions. The programmer can use fewer than three dimensions by setting the size of the unused dimensions to 1.
nodes.zh: 一般来说，网格是线程块的三维（3D）数组，而每个线程块是线程的 3D 数组。调用核函数时，程序需要指定网格和线程块在每一维上的大小。它们通过核函数调用语句的执行配置参数（位于【1】<<<【/1】…【2】>>>【/2】之内）来指定。第一个执行配置参数以线程块的数目指定网格的维度，第二个以线程的数目指定每个线程块的维度。每个这样的参数都具有【3】dim3【/3】类型，它是由【4】x【/4】、【5】y【/5】、【6】z【/6】三个元素构成的整型向量类型。这三个元素指定三个维度的大小。程序员可以把未使用维度的大小设为 1，从而使用少于三个的维度。

nodes.en: This allows the number of blocks to vary with the size of the vectors so that the grid will have enough threads to cover all vector elements. In this example the programmer chose to fix the block size at 256. The value of variable n at kernel call time will determine dimension of the grid. If n is equal to 1000, the grid will consist of four blocks. If n is equal to 4000, the grid will have 16 blocks. In each case, there will be enough threads to cover all the vector elements. Once the grid has been launched, the grid and block dimensions will remain the same until the entire grid has finished execution.
nodes.zh: 这使得线程块的数目可以随向量的大小而变化，从而让网格拥有足够的线程覆盖所有向量元素。在这个例子中，程序员选择把线程块大小固定为 256。核函数调用时变量 n 的取值将决定网格的维度。如果 n 等于 1000，网格将由 4 个线程块组成；如果 n 等于 4000，网格将有 16 个线程块。在这两种情况下，线程都足以覆盖全部向量元素。网格一旦启动，网格和线程块的维度就保持不变，直到整个网格执行完毕。

nodes.en: For convenience, CUDA provides a special shortcut for calling a kernel with one-dimensional (1D) grids and blocks. Instead of using dim3 variables, one can use arithmetic expressions to specify the configuration of 1D grids and blocks. In this case, the CUDA compiler simply takes the arithmetic expression as the x dimensions and assumes that the y and z dimensions are 1. nodes.zh: 为方便起见，CUDA 为使用一维（1D）网格和线程块调用核函数提供了一种特殊的简写形式。不必使用 dim3 变量，可以直接用算术表达式来指定 1D 网格和线程块的配置。此时，CUDA 编译器只是把该算术表达式当作 x 维度，并假定 y 维度和 z 维度均为 1。由此得到【1】图 2.12【/1】中所示的核函数调用语句：

nodes.en: Readers who are familiar with C++ would realize that this “shorthand” convention for 1D configurations takes advantage of how C++ constructors and default parameters work. The default values of the parameters to the 【1】dim3【/1】 constructor are 1. When a single value is passed where a 【2】dim3【/2】 is expected, that value will be passed to the first parameter of the constructor, while the second and third parameters take the default value of 1. The result is a 1D grid or block in which the size of the x dimension is the value passed and the sizes of the y and z dimensions are 1.
nodes.zh: 熟悉 C++ 的读者会意识到，这种针对 1D 配置的“简写”约定利用了 C++ 构造函数与默认参数的工作方式。【1】dim3【/1】构造函数各参数的默认值均为 1。当在期望【2】dim3【/2】的位置只传入单个值时，该值会传给构造函数的第一个参数，而第二个和第三个参数取默认值 1。其结果是一个 1D 网格或线程块，其 x 维度的大小为传入的值，y 维度和 z 维度的大小均为 1。

nodes.en: Within the kernel function, the x field of variables 【1】gridDim【/1】 and 【2】blockDim【/2】 are preinitialized according to the values of the execution configuration parameters. For example, if n is equal to 4000, references to 【3】gridDim.x【/3】 and 【4】blockDim.x【/4】 in the 【5】vectAddkernel【/5】 kernel will result in 16 and 256, respectively. Note that unlike the 【6】dim3【/6】 variables in the host code, the names of these variables within the kernel functions are part of the CUDA C specification and cannot be changed. That is, the 【7】gridDim【/7】 and 【8】blockDim【/8】 are built-in variables in a kernel and always reflect the dimensions of the grid and the blocks, respectively.
nodes.zh: 在核函数内部，变量【1】gridDim【/1】和【2】blockDim【/2】的 x 字段会根据执行配置参数的值预先初始化。例如，如果 n 等于 4000，在【5】vectAddkernel【/5】核函数中对【3】gridDim.x【/3】和【4】blockDim.x【/4】的引用将分别得到 16 和 256。注意，与主机代码中的【6】dim3【/6】变量不同，核函数内部这些变量的名字是 CUDA C 规范的一部分，不能更改。也就是说，【7】gridDim【/7】和【8】blockDim【/8】是核函数中的内置变量，始终分别反映网格和线程块的维度。

nodes.en: In CUDA C the allowed values of 【1】gridDim.x【/1】 range from 1 to 2【2】31【/2】 − 1,【3】【4】1【/4】【/3】 and those of 【5】gridDim.y【/5】 and 【6】gridDim.z【/6】 range from 1 to 2【7】16【/7】 − 1 (65,535). All threads in a block share the same 【8】blockIdx.x【/8】, 【9】blockIdx.y【/9】, and 【10】blockIdx.z【/10】 values. Among blocks, the 【11】blockIdx.x【/11】 value ranges from 0 to 【12】gridDim.x-1【/12】, the 【13】blockIdx.y【/13】 value ranges from 0 to 【14】gridDim.y-1【/14】, and the 【15】blockIdx.z【/15】 value ranges from 0 to 【16】gridDim.z-1【/16】.
nodes.zh: 在 CUDA C 中，【1】gridDim.x【/1】的允许取值为 1 至 2【2】31【/2】 − 1，【3】【4】1【/4】【/3】而【5】gridDim.y【/5】和【6】gridDim.z【/6】的允许取值为 1 至 2【7】16【/7】 − 1（65,535）。线程块中的所有线程共享相同的【8】blockIdx.x【/8】、【9】blockIdx.y【/9】和【10】blockIdx.z【/10】值。在各线程块之间，【11】blockIdx.x【/11】的取值范围为 0 至【12】gridDim.x-1【/12】，【13】blockIdx.y【/13】的取值范围为 0 至【14】gridDim.y-1【/14】，【15】blockIdx.z【/15】的取值范围为 0 至【16】gridDim.z-1【/16】。
